title: Creep
hook: The *one borrowed chord* that makes Creep hurt

chords.name: B
chords.text: Should be B minor. Going major adds *D♯*, a note outside the key.

chords.name: C
chords.text: That *D♯ rises to E*. The lift: bright, hopeful.

chords.name: Cm
chords.text: Borrowed from G minor. *E sinks to E♭* and the hope collapses.

chords.name: G
chords.text: Back home, but it *doesn't feel the same*.

cover_text: The one *borrowed chord* that makes it hurt
